title: Avoiding Sanitary Tee Mistakes on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: Using a standard sanitary tee on a horizontal drain line is a frequent error that leads to solid waste accumulation and frequent clogs. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from a horizontal branch into a vertical stack. When changing direction on a horizontal drain line, plumbers must use a wye with a 1/8 bend or a combination wye and eighth bend fitting. This creates a smooth, gradual sweep that maintains flow velocity and prevents solids from settling. Always check local plumbing codes for approved fitting orientations before completing rough-in drainage work.
